findings.note: Oilers preview (Nov 24): EDM is 0-2-1 in its last three, blew a 4-1 lead at STL, and Hyman sat after a vision-affecting migraine. Babcock expects Nugent-Hopkins back. EDM won 3 straight at home and 13 of the last 19 vs VGK.

ESPN game page lists Hyman and Nugent-Hopkins as OUT, with Nov 24 return estimates. It also lists Savoie and Regula on long-term IR and Andersen on IR-NR. VGK is 7-2-2 on the road, and the page shows no Vegas injuries.
Covers lists Edmonton at -130 on the moneyline, while a separate ESPN page showed VGK -118, so the two market snapshots conflict. Covers notes Vegas is 4-0 in its last 4 road games.
